cases.name: Cassandra Ann “Cassie” Holden
cases.narrative: On 6/15/1988, her body was He hit her 15 times in the head with a 2-pound rock while She had gone for a walk to pick flowers for her mother near her mother's home. Cassie was visiting her mother for the summer from her home in Idaho, where she lived with her father and stepmother.

cases.name: Marilyn Lee Hickey
cases.about: Her obituary said she was a homemaker, loved playing pool and was a big Elvis Presley fan. “If you see someone without a smile, give them yours.”
cases.narrative: On 9/10/1992, her half-naked body was discovered in her apartment. She was also found with a pair of scissors in her chest & it is believed she was stabbed post-mortem.

cases.name: Perleen June Bode
cases.about: Her obituary said she was a woman full of life, love and happiness, she enjoyed listening to music, car rides, making new friends and spending time with the ones she loved. She always brought joy and happiness to so many people.
